title: City View Chic
description:
This home boasts 3 bedrooms, 3 full baths, 2 half baths, full kitchen, living and dining room, and 2 sets of washers/dryers.  An air mattress is provided for addtl guests.  The highlight of this gem is the Rooftop Deck, a perfect spot to unwind and take in the stunning views of downtown Nashville and Nissan Stadium just a few miles away. Convenience is at your doorstep with a prime East Nashville location. Walk to trendy Five Points restaurants, music venues, bars, coffee shops, and shopping.

The space
3 master bedrooms (2 queen & 1 king), plus 2 half baths.  Air mattress can be used for the 7th and 8th guest

Other things to note
Favorite breakfast spot: Snooze (walking distance)
